meta_title: WebP to JPG Converter: Free & Private | Resize-It
meta_description: Convert WebP images to JPG so they open anywhere and upload to any form. Batch convert in your browser; transparent areas turn white.
subtitle: Saved an image from the web and got a .webp file? Convert it to JPG so it opens in any app and uploads to any form. Runs entirely in your browser.

tool_workspace.description: Drop one or more WebP files below, then click Convert Image.
features_list: Runs in your browser: no uploads

requirements.intro: Many websites serve images as WebP. That works in browsers, but some apps, printers and upload forms only accept JPG or PNG. Converting to JPG gives you the most widely accepted format.

rows.label: Compression
rows.value: WebP: Lossy or lossless (this tool saves lossy WebP at 90% quality). JPG: Lossy: some detail is thrown away each time it is saved.

rows.label: Transparency
rows.value: WebP: Yes, including in lossy mode. JPG: No. Transparent areas become a solid colour.

rows.label: Best for
rows.value: WebP: Images on websites, where smaller files load faster. JPG: Photos, and anywhere that needs maximum compatibility.

rows.label: Compatibility
rows.value: WebP: All current browsers. Some older desktop software and some upload forms still reject WebP. JPG: Opens everywhere: every browser, phone, app, printer and upload form.

requirements.notes_h3: Before you convert WebP to JPG
notes: Transparent areas become white, because JPG has no transparency. If you need to keep transparency, convert WebP to PNG instead.
Animated WebP files are converted as a single still image (the first frame).
The JPG is saved at 90% quality, a good balance between size and sharpness.
Use this when a form says "JPG or PNG only", or a program will not open the .webp file.

how_to.title: How to convert WebP to JPG
how_to.step1_text: Select or drag in one or more WebP files. They are read in your browser, not uploaded.
how_to.step2_text: JPG is already selected on this page. You can switch to another format if needed.
how_to.step3_text: Click Convert Image. Each image is redrawn and saved in the new format on your device.
how_to.step4_text: A single image downloads directly; several images download together as a ZIP.

items.q: Why can’t I open a WebP file?
items.a: Some older programs and upload forms do not support WebP. Converting it to JPG solves that.

items.q: What happens to a transparent background?
items.a: JPG cannot store transparency, so transparent areas are filled with white. Use WebP to PNG to keep them transparent.

items.q: Can I convert several WebP files at once?
items.a: Yes. Add multiple files and download them as a ZIP.
No. Conversion runs on your device.
